text:
jamie: hey folks — quick q from my first day: if my laptop/ssh/vpn isn't working, where do I post? also which bots should I subscribe to and what's the 'thread vs dm' rule here?

morgan: welcome! 
For infra/setup issues post in #eng-infra. If it's purely onboarding account stuff post in #new-hires.

ethan: ^ this. Tag @onboard-bot for automated help flows (password resets, VPN desk). If it's urgent and blocking your work, ping me or @morgan in the thread.

jamie: thanks — how do I subscribe to onboard-bot? is there a command?

onboard-bot: hi @jamie — to enable onboarding DM flows, open a DM with me and send `start onboarding`. For channel alerts you can run `/subscribe onboard` in #new-hires.

lisa: tiny etiquette note: please start a thread instead of replying in-channel for issue follow-ups — keeps the channel readable. Only @channel if it's a true site-wide alert.

jamie: got it. any recommended quicklinks or docs to bookmark?

morgan: bookmark: https://intranet.redwood.ai/onboarding (account setup + VPN) and https://intranet.redwood.ai/handbook/channel-guidelines (what goes where).

ethan: also, if you hit a permissions 403 in the cloud console, paste the minimal error and the command in the thread (don't paste creds). We avoid PII in public channels.

jamie: noted re: PII. should I DM people for 1:1 help or keep it in threads?

lisa: prefer threads for issues that others might hit later. DM for sensitive configs or if it's a quick 1-min ask. If you DM and it's useful, paste a redacted summary back to the thread for future folks.

onboard-bot: reminder: onboarding checklist step 3 (VPN) can be auto-troubleshot. DM `vpn help` to start.

jamie: awesome, thanks everyone! subscribing to onboard now and will post in #eng-infra if needed. :thumbsup:

morgan: welcome again — ping if anything else. :wave:
